nameInUI: Smart threat reaction (only the targeted flight evades)
descriptionInUI: DCS' stock Evade Fire breaks every aircraft that merely PERCEIVES a launch, so a single S-300 or naval salvo scatters dozens of jets from packages the missile was never aimed at. This parks every airplane at Passive Defense -- fly the route, use chaff and flares, hold formation -- and switches only the flight the missile is actually guiding on to Evade Fire, until that missile is gone. The target is read from the engine (weapon:getTarget), never guessed from geometry. The option is per-group, so the targeted FLIGHT evades rather than the single jet. Helicopters are untouched and keep stock Evade Fire. The trade: a flight facing a missile whose target the engine will not resolve flies straight instead of breaking, so AI attrition against dense SAM belts can rise. Turn this off to restore stock DCS behaviour.

specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Off by default. On, every tagged shot prints to the screen for all players and every untagged shot is written to dcs.log -- useful for a test flight, unusable in a mission with an anti-ship salvo in it.
